items.en_title: Los Angeles first-come deadline November 1, 2027: 99 affordable rentals
items.en_oneliner: A 99-home first-come opening closing November 1, 2027, the largest batch in Los Angeles this round. The window runs almost a year, so households in the income band can register early.
